Tarzan Trimming is an owner-led tree care business serving south Ontario. Specializing in tree pruning and limb removal for residential properties from Toronto through the Hamilton and Kitchener corridor. Honest quotes, clean work, no high-pressure pitch. By appointment, evenings and weekends.

Full tree removals coming as the business grows. For now, every pruning and limb job gets the same attention to detail that an arborist brings to a commercial crew.
